rule: clear = at least 80% of the field's pixels free of cloud/snow; water = open (class 1) + partial (class 2) surface water
summary: NASA OPERA saw more than half of this field under water in 4 of 4 winters with at least 5 clear satellite views (fetched for 2022-23 to 2026-27). Much of it is classed as partial surface water (shallow water mixed with stubble or soil), which greenness-based images can miss.

source.title: NASA/JPL OPERA Dynamic Surface Water Extent from HLS (OPERA_L3_DSWX-HLS_V1), 30 m
